reviews.t: If you’re looking for a reason to buy these, here it is!
reviews.x: I have been on the hunt for the perfect pair of lashes for 9 months now... I’ve had my eyes on these for a couple of months and finally took the plunge and purchased. I was always scared of volume lashes because from my past experiences with them, the band was way too hard to work with. Let me tell you about these mf’in lashes. They’re light, soft, noticeable, durable and hands down the easiest to apply. I am in awe of just how amazing these are. Ticked every one of my boxes; and for the price I

I LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE!!! These lashes!!! They’re such good quality and fit so well I didn’t even have to cut them I’ll defiantly order these again and I highly reckoned them if you love the glam look
I am a beginner & these lashes make it easy for me to put on myself! The lashes are very long, good for big eyes gals like me. There also very dramatic, so good for fancy outfits.

WOW 😮  I AM BLOWN AWAY THESE ARE EXCEPTIONAL LASHES!!! SOOO BEAUTIFUL I HAVE NOTHING TO WANT FROM ANY OTHER LASH BRAND THIS IT!! THESE ARE MY ULTIMATE GO TO LASHES SORRY FOR THE CAPS! BUT IM SO EXCITED AND HAPPY IVE FOUND MY SOULMATE LASHES ❤️❤️❤️🥰🥰🥰😩😩😩🥰🥰🥰❤️🥰❤️🥰🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌🙌💥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

These lashes are gorgeous. They could have been a bit thicker, but that's my fault for buying the more natural ones. I do absolutely love them though, they're beautiful, lightweight and you get 7 pairs!

These are the best lashes i have ever bought, i was not and I repeat not going to spend like $10 for one pair of lashes, somehow I found these and wow I’m in LOVEEEEE they are so cute and whispy!!! They make my makeup pop and make me feel sooo pretty! They def look way more expensive then how much they cost, and they’re also super duper sturdy I’ve cleaned them up to 6 times and they look just as good as the first time, absolutely recommend, Im also not the best at putting on my lashes so I apol

I order these lashes back in March and they were they best that I ever used.  I just ordered again and they are definitely not the same.  I compared them to the ones I purchased before and they are much thicker and longer.  I’m really disappointed because before I could were then everyday no matter the occasion.  I really hope they can start making them like the used to.

I bought two different styles, Dramatic & Wispies. I do like them a lot, i just wish the packaging would be different. Kinda each pair on its own. Also, it doesnt say which one is the dramatic and which one is wispie, so im not sure which one i want to order again. Other than that, theyre great. Got so many compliments wearing them. They are very very dramatic tho, so if you're more into a Natural look, these aren't for you.

[[VIDEOID:46e5f97cce32a29d29ac8141d20781ff]] Love these lashes! So beautiful, especially for the price. Only put 4 stars because some of the lashes were a little messed up when arrived. Like a few strands of lash got stuck in the glue when they were packaged. But, nothing I couldn’t work with. Love these lashes and will definitely buy again!

These eye lashes are 🔥!!!!! I saw these here on Amazon and I was alitttle skeptical because they looked similar to lashes that I had just purchased!! And boy was I filled, nothing like the old pair i bought!! I will definitely buy them again and again!! thank u
Omg!!!! I love these. There are soft and light weight. I have worn more expensive mink lashes and these are exactly like them. I got plenty of compliments. I will definitely be ordering more!!!
[[VIDEOID:dfc70812f427453ba9dc40cb32922f1c]] I absolutely love these lashes!! Everyone always ask me where did I get them from. Getting ready to order them again
I will definitely be buying these lashes again. They are a great value for the price, they are light weight and look great!
[[VIDEOID:f956783c0a7d5501cd3f65984814b093]] these are GREAT LASHES I highly recommend
Love them! They are so cute and they have the right amount of fluffiness and volume.
Soft, beautiful lashes. Excellent quality and quantity for price
I love lashes, and I’m happy I added these to my collection.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I like bold lashes but these were even too much for me. I tried to trim them but didn’t have much luck making them look decent. I also noticed that they straighten out when in heat. It doesnt looks good. You get what you pay for. I would say they are more costume lashes then every day wear. Decent cost for what you get but I would rather pay more and actually be able to use them. I ended up tossing them. I gave them I high rating because I didn’t feel they were misadvertized and they are very ve

I have started using lashes just a few weeks ago so I have gone on a spree looking for the perfect ones. And these are it!!!!!! I got the mink lashes. I was alitle worried that they would be too long but not at all. It's a perfect length and makes my eyes pop out even more. I love the band. Its alittle thicker which I really like. it's easier to apply and gives the illusion of eyeliner. Definitely will be making more purchases.

it's pretty dramatic for them being wispies, and extremely long. However, I didnt know the difference in length so that's on me, but whoever said they fit with glasses is absolutely lying. I tried trimming them, but obviously it did not go well. If you're looking for a more natural look to ease your way into lashes, I wouldn't say these are the ones for you, but if you just wanna go for it, these are great.

A friend told me about these after I asked where she got her lashes. They definitely are huge, not what I was expecting. I also dislike how they seem versatile meaning there is no left or right lash they are all basically one lash. They are lightweight and nice but longer than what they seem to appear. Dont like my lashes so long that they touch my brows when I'm looking forward.

A bit long (they went to my eyebrow) so I had to trim a few pairs for a more everyday look. The band is strong but pliable for you to both work on your eye and pull off residual glue for reuse. Due to how long they are & how they’re presented makes it hard to know right from left unless you really look. No faux shiny look, really soft and wispy. I get lots of compliments!

I purchased these for my daughter. She absolutely loves them. That says a lot since she can be picky at times. The price was great and they are beautiful on my daughter. I have also worn a pair. normally I would not wear them because they are not comfortable, but these were. I did not feel like they were on. Very nice.

I got the lashes in style wispies, super light weight, only issue I had was that they are extremely long (past my eyebrow) . When I close my eyes they look almost to thick. I totally think they are worth the price, they are super light weight, I think next time I'll just get them in a different style.

Packaging is super cute, long lashes with the perfect fullness (not too thin but alway not super dense and there are fluffy layers!). The band is also solid you’ll definitely get a few wears per set. Extremely satisfied exceeded my expectations especially for the price! Will be ordering more for sure

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lashes as beautiful, glamorous, and high quality.
Many customers say they will buy these lashes again or recommend them.
Several reviewers highlight the great value and low price compared to other lash brands.
Some customers note the lashes are lightweight and soft.
A few reviewers mention issues with consistency or condition on arrival, such as lashes being different from a previous order or strands stuck in glue.
